timing: Before any model inference or evaluation outcomes were inspected
reason: Initial split manifest had only 16 calibration components despite 263 rows and exceeded declared row caps. This cannot support useful group-aware uncertainty.
change: Whole-component packing enforces exact row caps; validation, calibration and evaluation draw components with at most eight claims, reserving these before development. limitation: Results apply to small-component FEVER population and may not generalize to large connected topics. Locked evaluation still runs once after candidate selection.
